adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, if the parsed token response lacks `refresh_token`, the code forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed response is parsed via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and then merged into persisted credentials with `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`. When credential syncing is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema` (which does not require `refresh_token`), so the fallback injects the literal string and the spread overwrites the real stored refresh token. That is a verifiable correctness/data-loss bug that will cause subsequent refresh attempts to use the bogus refresh token.
